contentPattern: A single embedded video referenced by a link (YouTube, Vimeo, or a direct video file), rendered at 16:9. A direct video file with no poster plays muted, looped and inline with a Mute/Unmute toggle overlaid top-center; an optional poster image turns it into click-to-play with a centered play button; YouTube/Vimeo links embed a player with controls. Optional heading + text authored in another cell renders beside the video (text left, video right) on desktop and stacked on mobile.
